name: Borda-pilot tuned block-sieve supplement
scope: All 19 distinct unresolved active E0/L0/S0 cells; repeat/draw ID 0 only. B0 aliases are not counted twice. P1/P2 legacy implementation guards are not retried.
outer_allocation: Reuse source ID 0 train/validation/test exactly; empirical allocation units preserved. No split reroll or additional shuffle.
pilot: Global clipped normalized Borda (manuscript equation 3.4) on half of fitting-pool units, with fixed label tie priority. The other half supplies sieve pairs.
blocks: Equal-size contiguous unpadded blocks in pilot order using numpy.array_split; concatenate fitted block orders.
local_estimator: Unchanged canonical-label lexicographic maximal permutation packing and exact selected-pair disagreement minimizer; one uniformly selected unordered pair per eligible report/block.
beta: Whole-ranking MLE on [0,10] using all reports in the current fitting pool.
selection: Lowest mean whole-ranking validation NLL among completed candidates; ties prefer fewer blocks. Refit on development in that order; if a refit exceeds the prespecified resource budget, try the next validation-ranked candidate and report the failure.
resource_budget: 120 seconds per exact solver call/packing construction, 4 GiB estimated working arrays; incomplete packing never used. Reuse exact packing cache by size/radius/budget.
comparators: Replay source PL, likelihood-center SM, eligible Fotakis and Efficient on exactly the same test data; additionally fit full-development Borda and pilot-half Borda with bounded dispersion.
uncertainty: 2000 paired test-unit percentile bootstrap replicates, conditional on fixed fitted models, for identified independent units and synthetic test reports. No population CI for anonymous Wheat reports; no split MCSE from one allocation.
interpretation: This changes Sharp's pilot and block geometry and has no claimed manuscript Sharp risk guarantee. Successful fits do not complete original Sharp. Synthetic repeat 0 is illustrative, not a new Monte Carlo risk estimate.
test_access: No test outcome selects grid, pilot fraction, blocks, resource settings, or model. Scope and ID zero selection use stored availability only.
